scope: Explicit receiver codec cache and optional request telemetry, unchanged protocol and default serving behavior

red.expected_failure: Malformed codec_cache_enabled was accepted before cache creation

checks: Strict malformed option rejection before cache creation
Absent/false opt-out and true opt-in through actual CLI HTTP server
Artifact seed and two distinct prepared compressed schema transfers retain one decoder: preparations1,hits1
Exact artifact and target bytes after server shutdown and store reopen
Observer write failure stops serving and unauthorized requests are not observed
Existing authentication, framing, HTTP, fresh-cache and ordinary serving tests pass

telemetry.scope: after process timing, before response; cumulative namespace-partitioned cache counters; request ordinal includes rejected request attempts, so gaps are visible

limitations: Local loopback qualification; no WAN results from these tests
No public transfer ID field or new wire telemetry; scope/request ordering joins the serialized campaign
No packet-level byte or TCP keep-alive claim
